Let the player create Wi-Fi and connect microphone phones to it. This local hotspot does not share Internet; online music may need mobile data. Some phones turn off their current Wi-Fi. For Internet sharing or a 5 GHz option, use system hotspot settings.

Allow the requested Wi-Fi permission to create the hotspot.
Reduces audio waiting time. Turn this off if you hear crackling or dropouts. Actual delay still depends on the phones and network.
For a delay check: set added delay to 0 and turn off microphone echo/reverb. Use a nearby, uncongested Wi-Fi network or the player hotspot. Try 5 GHz if available and keep devices close.
Scan to connect to player Wi-Fi

On the microphone phone, open Wi-Fi settings and tap the QR scanner. Scan this code and confirm connection, then return to KaraokeLink and choose the player. If prompted, stay connected without Internet.
Press and hold the button to unlock. A tap or Back will not stop the player. The power button can still turn off the screen.

Microphone connections stay active with the screen off or another app open. Some websites may pause their music in the background. Use touch lock to keep the player visible while avoiding accidental taps.
